text: fetchConfigFromExchange takes domain, emailAddress, abortSignal, username, password and confirmCallback. In the XML RedirectAddr branch, the recursive call instead passes username || emailAddress as the third argument and abortSignal last. That shifts the signal/auth/callback roles; the third argument is consumed by AbortSignal.any. The mismatch remains in the fixed accepted source. The ordinary FindConfig caller uses the new order correctly. Its inspected redirect test exercises HTTP 301 confirmation rather than this XML-address recursion, so that test is not evidence that this branch works. This is a static call-contract finding; no redirect was run.
title: The XML Autodiscover redirect still calls the new signature in the old argument order
